features: Material: The artificial Xmas trees are consist of shining tinsel and metal tubes with plastic base. Made of high quality PVC plastic, greatly enhances its compressive ability.
Dimension: The pop up Christmas tree is 6ft high, appropriate size makes it an eye-catching addition. It takes up little spaces, so it can fit into any narrow rooms and area.

Easy to Assemble & Store: No need of additional tools and professional experience, you can assemble the tree follow the instruction. You can easily disassemble and put it in the box when not using it.
Clever Design: Sturdy metal stand and surface spraying process can prevent rust effectively. The tripod is made of high quality thick plastic, it is evenly stressed to improve the stability of trees.
Wide Application: The tinsel trees can be used in living room, fireplace, staircase, bedroom, entrance, backyard, etc. Also a perfect gift idea for your families and friends.
